outcomes.verified: The task completed and was verified by {agent}.
outcomes.completed_unverified: {agent} finished, but the outcome was not verified.
outcomes.unverified: The outcome of {agent}'s task is unverified.

headings.criteria: How I know I am done

text.goal: Answer the request with the «{name}» agent.
text.criteria:
- the agent confirms the outcome of the task
- the answer reaches the user
text.risks_high: This agent can touch personal data, files or systems: sensitive actions ask for confirmation and the answer is not stored in clear text.
text.answer_sealed: Private answer, not stored in clear text ({chars} characters, fingerprint {digest}).
text.step_goal: Run the «{tool}» tool for the {agent} agent.
text.step_result_sealed: Private result, not stored in clear text ({chars} characters, fingerprint {digest}).
text.check_ok: The tool answered without errors in {ms} ms.
text.v_files: every file required by the level is present
text.v_outcome: the outcome was verified by the agent
text.verdict_superata: Check passed: the goal appears to be reached.
text.verdict_incompleta: Check incomplete: at least one confirmation is missing, the result is not guaranteed.
text.verdict_non_superata: Check failed: the work does not appear to have been completed correctly.
